quotes: "To address this gap, we explored the opportunities of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in supporting inter-generational communication in VR." (p. 1)

"We developed three types of AI probes, including Content Generation (i.e., image generation, 3D object generation, and scene generation), Communication Facilitator (i.e., chat facilitator and emotional visualization), and Info Assistant, as shown in Figure 1." (p. 5)
"Our workshop included three parts as shown in Figure 2." (p. 8)

"In this section, we further discuss our findings along the following aspects: 1) the advantages of leveraging AI in VR to enhance inter-generational communication and how this integration addressed issues of inter-generational communication, 2) the challenges of integrating AI to support inter-generational communication in VR and associated design implications, and 3) a comparison of AI facilitators with human facilitators to understand their respective strengths, weaknesses, and suitability in different contexts." (p. 18)
"We acknowledge five limitations that motivate potential future research directions:" (p. 22)

quotes: "Participants were free to use any of the AI probes to complete the task." (p. 10)

claim_entries.value: claim_exceeds_evidence
The paper's facilitation claim implies effectiveness, but the study measured perceptions and observed use without a standard-baseline comparison (PDF p. 22).

"We did not conduct comparative evaluations to gauge AI’s effectiveness against a standard task completion baseline." (p. 22)

paper_code_entries.value: both — The probes support immediate communication and were also envisioned for inter-generational life-skill learning (PDF pp. 1, 12).

quotes: "During the probe study, participants used Content Generation to create images and 3D objects to introduce concepts that were unfamiliar to another generation." (p. 12)

paper_code_entries.value: process — The study reports changes in mutual understanding, conversational fluency, and participation (PDF p. 11).
quotes: "We found that AI-powered VR was leveraged to enhance mutual understanding, foster conversation fluency, and promote active participation." (p. 11)

quotes: "The probes include three types of AI outputs: text/voice, images, and 3D objects/environments, and can be activated in two ways: passively and proactively." (p. 5)

paper_code_entries.value: problematizing — A turn-balancing reminder makes the dominant speaker attend to the other person's feelings (PDF p. 13).
quotes: "They appreciated the reminder of AI and thought it made them attentive to the other’s feelings during the conversation." (p. 13)

"The search engine functionality is powered by ChatGPT-3.5." (p. 7)

"Moreover, although our AI probe-based co-design workshop revealed interesting insights, it lasted for a relatively short period and was conducted in a controlled laboratory setting." (p. 22)
"These factors may compromise the authenticity and practical applicability of the experimental outcomes [71]." (p. 22)

cards.venue_as_written: Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction (CSCW)

true — the ACM reference supplies the complete identity (PDF p. 2).

identity_entries.value: motivation pp. 1–5; interface pp. 6, 8–12; evaluation pp. 13–24; limitations pp. 25–26.
quotes: "We examine to what extent AI-powered automatic note-taking services might reduce valuable cognitive engagement of the note-taker and how we could design human-AI collaborative mechanisms to provide the necessary AI assistance to the note-taker while preserving the cognitive effort required for meaningful content engagement." (p. 2)

"We developed NoteCopilot, an AI-assisted note-taking system offering adjustable levels of AI assistance - Minimal AI, Intermediate AI, Automated AI, each tailored to examine different degrees of cognitive assistance in note-taking." (p. 8)

"To assess users’ understanding of the lecture, we graded students’ two rounds of post-test answers, i.e., immediately after the lecture, and after the participants revised their answers based on the notes." (p. 13)
"We acknowledge the limitations of this work." (p. 25)

paper_code_entries.value: real-time lecture note-taking and learning — (PDF p. 4).

(p. 4)

paper_code_entries.value: both — the support targets note-taking behavior and immediate learning outcomes (PDF p. 12).
quotes: "RQ1: How do different levels of AI assistance affect learning outcomes, cognitive load, note-taking behaviors, and usability?" (p. 12)

paper_code_entries.value: novice_or_learner — participants were students selected because they experienced note-taking difficulty (PDF p. 6).
quotes: "We selected participants who indicated that they faced challenges in note-taking." (p. 6)

paper_code_entries.value: coordination_or_memory_gap — learners must capture, select, and organize live information that cannot be revisited while managing working-memory load (PDF p. 2).
quotes: "Note-taking has proven to be a helpful tool to assist real-time information consumption by externalizing information and reducing the load on participants’ working memory." (p. 2)

paper_code_entries.value: process — the study logged how participants used the panels and editor (PDF p. 14).
quotes: "Throughout the experiment, we systematically logged users’ interactions with the interface." (p. 14)

paper_code_entries.value: artifact — the study measured the amount and authorship of note content (PDF p. 14).
quotes: "We also recorded the content created in the Text Editor, distinguishing between notes generated by AI and those created by users." (p. 14)

paper_code_entries.value: learning_or_transfer — the two test rounds assessed immediate understanding and note-supported revision (PDF p. 13).
quotes: "The second round allowed students to revise their initial answers using their notes, called the Revision Score." (p. 13)

paper_code_entries.value: structuring — the three representations progressively transform transcript chunks into summaries and structured notes (PDF p. 12).
quotes: "Finally, the Automated AI system consolidates all short summaries into structured notes that include definitions and advantages of forced display." (p. 12)

paper_code_entries.value: problematizing — intermediate support deliberately leaves evaluation and reorganization to the learner instead of removing the challenge (PDF p. 24).
quotes: "Unlike Automated AI, which presents finalized content, Intermediate AI invites learners to evaluate, modify, and reorganize the information." (p. 24)

paper_code_entries.value: contingency — query responses depend on the user’s expressed request (PDF p. 8).
quotes: "Users can submit a query (b1), and the AI provides responses that are aligned with the AI assistance levels based on their request (b2)." (p. 8)

paper_code_entries.value: llm_or_foundation_model — GPT-4o produced summaries, thematic groupings, and structured notes (PDF p. 12).
quotes: "In Intermediate AI, these segments were passed to the LLM model to produce concise summaries, which were shown immediately after each lecture turn, simulating real-time generation." (p. 12)

paper_code_entries.value: llm_era — the semantic representations were produced with an LLM/GPT-4o pipeline (PDF p. 12).
quotes: "In Intermediate AI, these segments were passed to the LLM model to produce concise summaries, which were shown immediately after each lecture turn, simulating real-time generation." (p. 12)
